name: Grain sacks
description: A heap of three plump burlap grain sacks, two lying side by side and one propped on top, each tied at the neck with twine; the coarse cloth is a warm desaturated tan with a darker patch or two, slightly slumped and lumpy, about 0.7 m high. A variant is a single upright sack about 0.6 m high.

provenance.prompt: A heap of three plump burlap grain sacks for a village yard or storeroom: two lying side by side and one propped on top, tied at the neck with twine, the coarse cloth a warm desaturated tan with a darker patch or two, slightly slumped and lumpy. About 0.7 m high, inside one tile. Container family sack. Static (not destructible, not interactive), blocks movement, does not block sight, cover half. A variant `sacks_grain_one` is a single upright sack, about 0.6 m high, that blocks nothing (cover none).
